Yea yea I've been hearing the "ETH is dead" FUD for literally years now.

The last time people were screaming this on CT a year ago I made a Youtube video explaining exactly why it WASN'T dead, literally 5 DAYS before the pico-bottom (check the dates) after which we rallied 255% to NEW ALL TIME HIGHS.

Funny enough, we are trading at almost exactly the same price now, I am hearing the same thing again, and we are gonna RUN IT BACK but this time we don't just eclipse prior ATH we are gonna smash far past them.

Will make a new Youtube vid soon to break down exactly why, just like last time.

$ETH season soon.

Here we go again.

Encouraged all the grifters and "celebs" to come rinse the space one more time, as if the first time wasn't enough.

Great job folks, let's keep cheering this behavior on and cannibalizing the little liquidity that's left. 

Bravo ������������������

Its a tough sell, why pure play is better.

If you have to do both (maybe because of path dependency) then the best setup for project with onchain revenue is to commoditize the complement (the offchain product), in order to grow the onchain protocol bigger. Uniswap did this recently. https://t.co/IbLcxapnNv

This relies on the assumption giving away the product will be a growth driver, specifically creating network effects that make the protocol bigger and more valuable than any single equity business could be.
